title: Hello, You
description:
**Goal:** Personal greeting program.
```
What's your name? Ada Lovelace
How old are you? 36
Hello, Ada Lovelace! Next year you'll be 37.
In dog years you are 252.
```
hints: Use `std::getline(std::cin >> std::ws, name);` if you read the name after a number.
requirements: Print next year's age and age × 7
stretch: also ask for a birth year and print the age they'll turn in 2050.
